$comment: Aurelia Browser - Chromium pin configuration (single source of truth).
Never edit the revision fields by hand after a release: the update bot proposes
a change to this file, and a maintainer merges it after the patch set has been
Do not replace `revision` with a moving ref such as `main` or `latest`.

chromium.pinRationale: Latest patch level available for the current stable milestone series at pin time, so the baseline includes current stable security fixes rather than an older branch point.

rules: Never merge a Chromium update directly into main.
Detect -> open an issue with a candidate revision and the patch verification report -> verify patch set -> heavy build + smoke test -> maintainer merge.
Security releases are prioritised but still verified before merge.
A pin change requires a matching `git apply` verification against the new revision.

depotTools.why: depot_tools is not mirrored on GitHub and the scaffolding sandbox cannot reach chromium.googlesource.com, so no revision has been pinned yet. Do not invent one: resolve it on the heavy builder with `git -C depot_tools rev-parse HEAD`, record it here, and re-run tools/chromium/sync.mjs.

referenceBuilder.notes: Measured requirements are recorded once real builds run; see docs/BUILDING-CHROMIUM.md.

buildRequirements.sandboxNote: The development sandbox used for scaffolding has ~20 GB free disk and cannot hold or build a Chromium checkout. Only lightweight upstream file verification runs there.
